decisions.reason: As a low-cost dental consumable line tightly tied to the firm's core laboratory workflow business, it is reasonable to keep it unless several years of sales now clearly show persistent weakness.

The contrast spray still fits the firm's digital and clinical workflow positioning, but as a narrower adjunct product its value should by now be fairly visible, so it is kept with somewhat higher review pressure.

Custom earmolds are strongly aligned with the firm's hearing-care capabilities, specialist channels, and custom-manufacturing strengths, making this an attractive line to retain unless performance is plainly disappointing.
